meta.scope: Current-constituent selected-sector pilot; not full S&P 500
meta.method: LM affect + quarterly 3-month returns + expanding OOS ridge

modules.question: 기업 어조는 향후 시장 대비 수익률과 관련되는가?
modules.method: Quarterly cross-sectional Spearman IC, whole sample and GICS sectors; HAC over quarters.

modules.question: 바텀업·탑다운·결합 정보 중 무엇이 추가 예측력을 제공하는가?
modules.method: Same-sample expanding OOS ridge; baseline controls, BU, TD with sector interactions, combined; minimum 12 matured training quarters.

modules.question: 물가·고용·성장·투자·금리 주제의 관계는 섹터마다 다른가?
modules.method: Common topic lexicon, missing-topic preservation, sector IC and sector-conditioned macro features.

modules.question: 어조 괴리는 어느 쪽의 조정으로 축소되는가?
modules.method: Expanding past-only standardization; |gap|≥1; next-quarter 25% gap reduction with origin scaling frozen.

modules.question: 다른 출처의 어조를 추가하면 다음 어조 예측이 개선되는가?
modules.method: Expanding OOS AR(1) vs AR(1)+other-source tone, both directions, overall and sectors.

modules.question: 전체 문서의 FinBERT가 LM보다 수익률을 더 잘 예측하는가?
modules.reason: Return results use LM. The separate sampled-sentence agreement experiment is not a FinBERT return backtest; that comparison requires the identical full corpus and leakage-safe rerun.

findings.title: 실제 자료로 실행한 탐색적 파일럿
findings.text: 33개 기업·11개 섹터, 기업 문서 1,334건과 FOMC 80건을 처리했습니다. S&P 500 전체의 결론으로 확대할 수 없습니다.

findings.title: 수익률 오차와 종목 순위는 다른 결과를 보인다
findings.text: 26개 평가 분기에서 OOS RMSE가 가장 낮은 것은 기본 통제변수 모델(0.1285)입니다. 결합 모델 RMSE는 0.1418이며, 평균 순위 IC는 결합 0.0535, 탑다운 0.0492, 바텀업 -0.0225입니다. 수익률 수준의 오차와 종목 순위는 다른 평가 기준입니다. 제한된 분기 표본의 탐색 결과로 모형 우월성이 확증된 것은 아닙니다.

findings.title: 어조의 선행 정보 차이는 작다
findings.text: 전체 어조의 다음 분기 예측에서 자기 전기 값만 사용한 모형보다, 탑다운 정보를 추가한 바텀업 어조 RMSE는 2.32% 감소, 바텀업 정보를 추가한 탑다운 어조 RMSE는 1.55% 증가했습니다(27개 OOS 시점). 작은 탐색적 차이이며 경제·실적 예측의 정확성이나 정보원의 우월성을 확증하지 않습니다.

limitations: Selected current S&P 500 companies are a feasibility sample, not the historical S&P 500 universe; survivorship and nonrandom selection prevent index-wide generalization.
Current GICS sector labels are held fixed; historical reclassifications and constituent membership are not reconstructed.
LM dictionary affect scores do not identify hawkishness, cost versus demand channels, or the economic direction of inflation/employment. Topic scores are common-topic tone proxies.
SEC acceptance is used as conservative availability; actual investor-relations release can precede SEC filing. Quarter-end inputs discard releases on the final trading day.
Only disclosures no more than 120 days old enter formation; source collection failures can create nonrandom exclusions.
OOS estimates use a selected pilot and limited quarterly observations. HAC t-statistics do not correct dozens of topic/sector comparisons; all findings are exploratory.
FOMC information is common across firms in each quarter; the macro time-series sample is the number of quarters, not the number of company-quarter rows.
Topic means include only firms that mention the topic. Their composition and counts can change over time, especially with only three selected firms per sector.
Market-adjusted BHAR equals stock buy-and-hold return minus broad US market buy-and-hold return; it is not factor alpha or an S&P 500-only benchmark.
Long-short returns assume 100% long and 100% short exposure, quarterly close execution and 10 bp per dollar traded. Borrow fees, funding, slippage and market impact are unmodeled.

The full-corpus FinBERT return backtest, EPS-surprise controls, accounting-outcome validation and causal identification are not part of the executed LM pilot. A separate sampled LM/FinBERT agreement experiment does not establish return predictive superiority.
Text lead-lag and convergence describe source language. They do not establish which institution is correct about the economy or guarantee return predictability.

validation.point_in_time: All disclosure timestamps < final trading date 00:00 UTC. All training outcomes end strictly before test formation date.

market.source: Local classroom CRSP CIZ monthly total returns; Ken French monthly factors
market.license: Local use only; do not publish security-level source/derived return rows without redistribution rights.

validation.momentum_control: Three completed calendar months ending one month before entry; entry-month return is unavailable at signal cutoff.
